pages.text: You may have noticed that you've become a bit tougher—great news!$(br)However, any damage you receive will be converted into various types of $(l:dgh:injury)wounds$(). If not properly treated, these wounds may lead to even more harm.$(br)Press O (default) to open the Health Panel and visually inspect your own condition.$(br)If you have a $(l:dgh:tools)Health Scanner$() and a $(l:dgh:tools)Blood Scanner$(), you can obtain more detailed information or even check other players’ status.

The main factors that deal direct damage to your life include: $(l:dgh:injury)wounds$(), brain damage, and poisoning. Wounds come from all direct damage sources, brain damage results from complications of injuries and body conditions, while poisoning comes from medications.$(br2)You cannot see all health information with the naked eye—symptoms only provide partial hints. You will need a $(l:dgh:tools)Health Scanner$() and $(l:dgh:tools)Blood Scanner$() for proper diagnosis.

After surviving for a long time, your body becomes seasoned and well-trained. As a result, your movement speed, mining speed, and attack speed will all increase.$(br2)Likewise, whenever you successfully heal your injuries, your body becomes more resilient.$(br2)If you narrowly escape death, you will receive a temporary powerful buff.
